PLAYER PERSONA

A game full of lost moments

MEET

Arjun, 19

Amateur cricket and football player who plays local matches every weekend. Passionate, competitive, and hungry to improve.

Grassroots players have the passion to compete, but lack a simple, connected way to record matches, track performance, and discover opportunities.

Match results in WhatsApp groups

Stats tracked in notebooks

No performance trends visible

No connected sporting identity

Key insight: players need one connected place to score, track and improve.

DISCOVERY PHASE

Research and market insights

1

2

Online surveys: cricket, football, kabaddi communities

3

Competitive analysis of scoring platforms

4

Pain point mapping and task analysis

Arjun · Amateur player, 19

Plays cricket and football. Wants to track performance and needs fast, friction-free scoring.

Rajesh · Coach / organizer

Manages local players and tournaments. Needs reliable match scoring and team visibility.

Core pain points: scoring complexity and manual entry friction • fragmented match info across platforms • no personal statistics or performance tracking • hard to discover local sports opportunities

IDEATION PHASE

Paper prototype

Flow 1 · Start a match

Home screen → Select sports → Select playing teams.

Flow 2 · Build the squad

Select team (yours and opponent) → Select players → Select player roles: captain, keeper, 12th man.

Design decisions iterated

Reducing score entry friction, making sport switching intuitive, improving stats readability, and keeping things consistent across sports.

USABILITY + ACCESSIBILITY
